name: Songal’s Elemental Suffusion

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: Gain resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder, and Fly 30 feet with hover. On casting and each turn start, chosen creatures in a 15-foot Emanation save Dexterity against 2d6 of one of those types and Prone; success takes half damage only. Circle variant takes 1 minute to cast, lasts 10 minutes with Concentration, and grants the benefits to one extra creature per secondary caster (maximum nine); each secondary caster spends a level 2+ slot.
